release.notes: Android Auto tiles back to their earlier look on a transparent background (no grey frame, continuous charge gauge, door dots); clearer Dashboard and Main tile names (HV battery peak, Battery power, 12V battery); Driving/Charging buttons in Graphs; nameplate photo zoom and an optional note to support; Pre-purchase Check waits longer for live data and estimates distance from speed when the odometer stands still; MG4 odometer; Ioniq 5 58/63 module temperatures; Ioniq 28 motor torque and pedal; MEB car clock; BMS cell min/max shown only when fresh; Logbook for the evDash recorder adapter.
